title: Sentinel-1 SAR Satellite
content: Sentinel-1 is an ESA C-band SAR satellite constellation providing all-weather, day-night imagery. Specifications: wavelength 5.6cm (C-band), IW mode resolution 10m, swath width 250km, repeat cycle 6 days (constellation). Polarization modes: VV, VH, HH, HV. Applications: maritime monitoring, flood mapping, agricultural monitoring, ice monitoring, displacement measurement via InSAR. Free data access via Copernicus Open Access Hub. Sentinel-1A launched 2014, Sentinel-1B (failed 2021), Sentinel-1C planned 2023.

title: Sentinel-2 Multispectral Satellite
content: Sentinel-2 is an ESA multispectral satellite constellation for land monitoring. Specifications: 13 spectral bands (443-2190nm), 10m resolution (visible/NIR bands), 20m (red-edge/SWIR), 60m (coastal, water vapor), 290km swath, 5-day revisit. Free data access. Key bands: B4 (Red 665nm), B8 (NIR 842nm), B11 (SWIR 1610nm). NDVI = (B8-B4)/(B8+B4). Applications: vegetation monitoring, agriculture, urban mapping, water quality. Used extensively for COVID-19 lockdown monitoring and wildfire mapping.

title: Landsat-8/9 Satellite
content: Landsat-8 and Landsat-9 are USGS/NASA Earth observation satellites providing 30m multispectral imagery. Landsat-8 bands: 11 bands including coastal/aerosol, blue, green, red, NIR, SWIR-1, SWIR-2, panchromatic (15m), cirrus, thermal (100m). 16-day revisit, 185km swath. Free data access via USGS EarthExplorer. 50-year Landsat archive is unparalleled for long-term change detection. USGS Level-2 products provide surface reflectance and surface temperature. Landsat 9 launched 2021 with identical specifications to Landsat-8.

title: WorldView-3 High-Resolution Satellite
content: WorldView-3 is a commercial sub-meter resolution satellite operated by Maxar Technologies. Specifications: 0.31m panchromatic, 1.24m multispectral (8 bands), 3.7m SWIR (8 bands), 30m CAVIS (12 bands), 13.1km swath. This is among the highest-resolution commercial satellites available. Applications: infrastructure mapping, military intelligence, urban planning, disaster response. Daily revisit capability. Extremely high-resolution imagery allows detection of individual vehicles, small buildings, and fine surface features.
